priority_items.title: JTWC NR 004 names TD 29W (CHAMPI) still 30 kt; leftover Typhoon Watch / TCP 3A; Guam COR 3 first-file; TCV still none
priority_items.summary: This-window JTWC WTPN32 PGTW 150900 Warning NR 004 (LM 07:54:12 GMT) names Tropical Depression 29W (CHAMPI) still 030 kt at 10.9N 158.4E (~809 nm east of Andersen). Forecast 035/045/055/065/080/095 kt through 72h; next 151500Z. ABPW10 PGTW 150800 reissue (LM 08:03:14 GMT) prints the name; 92P still MEDIUM at 8.3S 164.7W. Leftover NWS TCP Intermediate 3A (LM 06:50:02 GMT) still 35 mph at 10.7N 158.5E with CHANGES None; leftover HLS 349 PM / CAP O.CON (updated 08:49:58Z; leftover SPS dropped). TCV still none. KUAM first-file (parent-daily miss; datePublished 07:28:18Z): Gov Leon Guerrero directed COR 3 as of 5:00 p.m. Thursday / 07:00 UTC. Stripes tracker #5 LM 08:15:00 GMT corroborates COR 3 + Champi; Sunday-over-Guam Cat-1 90-mph is media CLAIM vs JTWC 72h 095 kt. GHS HTML still leftover TCFA + Cat-2 prepare slug. PDN crane LM 08:02:42 GMT: Gantry 6 returned; Yankee anticipated not in force. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: FMS TDS 150844 UTC upgrades TD01F to LOW TO MODERATE; JTWC 92P still MEDIUM; Gale 002 leftover waters-only

Leftover Gale Warning 002 (150658 UTC) still 35 kt waters-only in box 02-04S 166-170W. Leftover JTWC ABPW 150800 still MEDIUM on 92P at 8.3S 164.7W. No named Southwest Pacific cyclone. Not a Fiji-land warning. Not FLASH.
